metaDescription: A sector-by-sector guide to identifying mandatory industry licenses in Nepal. Travel, liquor, food processing, foreign trade, and health regulations.
h1: How to Identify the Licenses and Local Approvals a Business May Need
directAnswer: To identify the specific licenses and approvals your business needs in Nepal, examine your operational sector: general companies require only OCR and Municipal Ward registration; import/export businesses require an EXIM Code from Customs; tourism firms need Department of Tourism permits; food/beverage entities require Department of Food Technology and Quality Control (DFTQC) licenses; and industrial factories require Department of Industry environmental clearances.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.h2: Navigating Nepal's Multi-Tiered Regulatory Licensing Ecosystem
sections.contentHtml: Incorporating a company at the Office of Company Registrar (OCR) grants legal personality, but it does NOT automatically confer the right to start commercial operations. Depending on your industry vertical, geography, and scale, businesses in Nepal must navigate a multi-tiered hierarchy of national, departmental, and municipal approvals before transacting legally.

Below are the primary statutory bodies and permits required across prominent commercial sectors in Nepal:

Industry SectorGoverning Regulatory BodyKey Operating Approvals
Tourism, Travel & TrekkingDepartment of Tourism / Ministry of CultureTourism Agency Operating License & Bank Guarantee
Import & Export TradeDepartment of Customs / Trade Promotion CenterEXIM Code & NPR 300,000 Bank Guarantee Certificate
Food, Beverage & ProcessingDFTQC (खाद्य प्रविधि तथा गुण नियन्त्रण विभाग)Product Quality Certification & Hygiene Permits
Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)Department of Industry (DOI) / NRBFITTA Foreign Capital Approval & Currency Clearance
Information Technology & BPODepartment of Industry / Nepal Rastra BankForeign Currency Earning Registration & Repatriation
Education & Skill ConsultingMinistry of Education, Science & TechnologyConsultancy Operating Approval & Premises Clearance

Under the Local Government Operation Act 2074, every commercial establishment must register with the local Municipal Ward Office within 30 days of establishing a physical address. Operating without local ward registration risks municipal padlocking and daily compounding fines. Key prerequisites include a registered rent agreement, house tax clearance of the owner, and sign-board tax payment.

faqs.question: How long does it take to secure an EXIM code for import and export?
faqs.answer: Once your company has registered with the OCR, obtained a VAT certificate, and secured an NPR 300,000 bank guarantee from a licensed commercial bank, the Department of Customs typically issues the EXIM code within 2 to 3 business days.

faqs.question: Can foreign investors operate in retail trading in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Under the Foreign Investment and Technology Transfer Act (FITTA 2019), retail trading and real estate brokerage are placed on the negative list, restricting 100% foreign-owned direct investment in consumer retail.
